claims: WrestleMania 42 streams at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT) on April 18–19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 streams via ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo) in the U.S.
The exclusive home for WrestleMania 42 in the U.S. is the ESPN App via the ESPN Unlimited plan.
WrestleMania 42 is available on Netflix outside the U.S.
Netflix is now the global home for WWE.
DirecTV Stream offers a 5-day free trial.
Sling TV (Sling Orange) provides access to ESPN/ESPN2 for the opening hours.
The WrestleMania Countdown show begins at 3:00 pm ET.
The WrestleMania Countdown show provides three hours of analysis.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT on both Saturday and Sunday.
The main card of WrestleMania 42 is from Allegiant Stadium.
The Get Ready For WrestleMania 42 collection is available on ESPN.
